desktop.notes:
• Virtual desktops (☰ menu): each desktop gets its own background, set automatically: a colour, a gradient (direction + second colour) or a set. Defaults: Work blue, School orange, Houdini/Unreal grey, Photography brown-to-sky gradient.
• Optional title and/or transparent logo per desktop, bottom-left above the taskbar, on the main or all screens.
• One Wallpaper Studio theme is saved and kept current after Set as wallpaper, Slideshow and desktops.
• *Set as wallpaper* now really stops a running slideshow, with a shorter confirm.
• Fill empty from Library: every empty screen / collage cell gets an album photo (best shape fit, no repeats).
• Colour swatches open presets (Work blue, School orange, grey, Nature gradient) and + for any colour (Windows colour picker). Collage backgrounds can be a gradient: one arrow button turns the direction, a small slider leans the blend towards either colour.
• Title or logo per set (off by default): text, or a PNG / JPG / SVG logo (transparency kept), bottom-left above the taskbar on the main or all screens, with a dark box or a drop shadow. Each copy moves, resizes and goes on its own (drag, corner, × or Del). Exported on top.
• Shorter hints and explanations throughout.
